data.long_meaning: The name Rochette originated from the French word 'roche', which means 'rock'. This name was given to girls to symbolize their strong and unyielding spirit, like a rock that stands firm in the face of adversity. The name Rochette carries the meaning “Little rock” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rochette usually hope their child will grow to embody little rock and live with faith, good character and purpose.
